房东借棚待客，修修补补不误约见评委。
拄拐小波也提议，全街鼓掌目标一致。
主管搭档同事相识陌生人齐夸，小英雄受敬。
戏剧喝彩加官方支持，选出代表继续冲刺。
顾问律师裁判后勤到场，比赛有序又暖心。
理发师渔夫屠夫庆功，辛苦换来清水和勇气。

title: 身体与时间
zh: 备考的一天与奶奶的健康年，两卷读完。
paragraphs: In the early morning Leo does a kind [[deed:deed]] to [[accustom:accustom]] himself to waking early.
He hears the [[alarm:alarm]] and learns to [[react:react]] fast and [[reflect:reflect]] calmly on yesterday.
Leo must [[bear:bear]] the cold air and [[adopt:adopt]] a strong plan for the long day.
A warm breakfast [[can:can]] [[nourish:nourish]] his body while father helps [[mow:mow]] the [[grass:grass]] in front of the house.
Leo steps [[outside:outside]] to [[exhale:exhale]] white air and check his daily food [[intake:intake]] plan.
A cup of hot milk [[can:can]] [[revive:revive]] his tired head so he [[can:can]] [[survive:survive]] busy mornings.
The low sun sends a sharp [[glare:glare]] but Leo gets a quick [[glimpse:glimpse]] of the bus.
Leo takes a quick [[glance:glance]] at his watch and has a [[peep:peep]] down the long road through the trees.
His [[steady:steady]] [[gaze:gaze]] stays on the road while he tries to [[peer:peer]] through light morning rain.
He [[contemplate:contemplated]] the stars and [[stare:stared]] at the [[night:night]] sky.
An [[oath:oath]] was taken and a solemn [[vow:vow]] made silently.
A [[pledge:pledge]] was given and the [[whistler:whistler]] sang softly.
Leo will [[reply:reply]] to his mother and [[notify:notify]] his friend about the late bus.
He likes to [[assert:assert]] his idea clearly and then [[explain:explain]] the bus [[delay:delay]] calmly.
Two boys start a loud [[quarrel:quarrel]] but the driver stops the small [[dispute:dispute]] quickly.
After the short [[argument:argument]] Leo must [[hasten:hasten]] on foot to reach the school gate.
A kind [[guard:guard]] seems to [[urge:urge]] him to run and does not [[scold:scold]] him for lateness.
Leo will not [[curse:curse]] the bad luck and will not [[swear:swear]] at the heavy [[traffic:traffic]].
A rude shout could [[provoke:provoke]] ire but the teacher only wants to [[preach:preach]] patience.
Leo does not [[boast:boast]] about his scores and does not [[tease:tease]] his tired classmates.
Nobody will [[mock:mock]] his accent and many friends will [[clap:clap]] for his short speech.
Classmates loudly [[applaud:applaud]] his effort as Leo tries to [[catch:catch]] each useful word.
He does not [[snatch:snatch]] other books and does not [[grab:grab]] pens from shared desks.
Leo wants to [[overtake:overtake]] his old self and keep a firm [[grip:grip]] on daily habits.
The [[mess:mess]] was cleaned and the [[twist:twist]] in the rope undone.
Each [[fold:fold]] was smoothed and nothing left to [[scatter:scatter]].
Every [[fasten:fastening]] was checked and nothing left to [[loosen:loosen]].
The desk will not be [[smash:smashed]] in ire nor the wall [[scratch:scratched]] with his pen.
Mud is [[scrape:scraped]] from shoes, and the old classroom windows are [[polish:polished]] till they shine.
The cleaning tasks will be [[split:split]] evenly while trees [[sway:sway]] gently [[outside:outside]] the window.
His [[phone:phone]] starts to [[vibrate:vibrate]] softly while [[dust:dust]] seems to [[whirl:whirl]] in the warm light.
The fan blades [[rotate:rotate]] slowly above as Leo feels his tired head [[reel:reel]].
Students [[shuffle:shuffle]] their feet at lunch time but do not [[collide:collide]] in the [[narrow:narrow]] hall.
Leo likes to [[combine:combine]] rice with vegetables and [[integrate:integrate]] [[fruit:fruit]] into his lunch.
The smell of good food seems to [[penetrate:penetrate]] the hall and [[pierce:pierce]] his sleepy afternoon mood.
He will [[insert:insert]] his meal card quickly and [[tilt:tilt]] his [[tray:tray]] to keep it [[steady:steady]].
After lunch friends [[tow:tow]] the ball bag together and follow the dusty [[trail:trail]] to the courts.
They help to [[arrange:arrange]] cones in lines and learn to [[manipulate:manipulate]] the ball well.
The coach teaches Leo to [[steer:steer]] his runs and lets sweat [[baptise:baptise]] his shirt in the hot sun.
Nobody wants to [[bet:bet]] money on the game or put pride at [[stake:stake]] after school.
They will not [[gamble:gamble]] with safety and only share a fair [[promise:promise]] to play clean.
Fast games always [[attract:attract]] many students but Leo does not [[obsess:obsess]] over final scores.
[[smooth:Smooth]] moves [[can:can]] [[mesmerize:mesmerize]] young fans but missing shots feels like a short [[nightmare:nightmare]].
Leo [[can:can]] [[amaze:amaze]] his team with passes and they [[marvel:marvel]] at his quick footwork.
His [[jump:jump]] [[can:can]] [[astonish:astonish]] tall rivals and [[involve:involve]] every friend in loud cheers.
A bad call may [[annoy:annoy]] tired players but must not [[upset:upset]] their friendly mood.
Strange rules [[can:can]] [[bewilder:bewilder]] new players and that is the small [[irony:irony]] of street games.
Leo hates the [[indignity:indignity]] of cheating and shows [[contempt:contempt]] for rude [[foul:foul]] play.
He will not show [[neglect:neglect]] for [[training:training]] rules or [[disregard:disregard]] for the coach’s voice.
Playing through [[ignorance:ignorance]] of rules shows [[bias:bias]] and often brings needless fouls.
Leo will not [[deviate:deviate]] from fair play or face orders to [[expel:expel]] him from the court.
He will not [[flee:flee]] from strong rivals or [[bully:bully]] smaller kids on the [[court:court]].
The last seconds [[can:can]] bring [[panic:panic]] but loud shouts should not [[terrify:terrify]] young players.
Thoughts of [[revenge:revenge]] for last [[loss:loss]] cannot [[kidnap:kidnap]] his calm and friendly mood.
Nobody [[can:can]] [[hijack:hijack]] the happy game or [[smuggle:smuggle]] bad feelings into the team.
In the stories we read, fair judges [[convict:convict]] cheaters, while stress tries to [[strangle:strangle]] pleasure.
It was no bloody [[massacre:massacre]] of scores, only a fair [[decimation:decimation]] of old fears.
The coach may [[intervene:intervene]] to stop fights that [[impede:impede]] our happy games on the court.
[[victory:Victory]] has strong [[allure:allure]] but sweet words are only [[bait:bait]] for heedless young minds.
Kind cheers [[can:can]] [[induce:induce]] fresh energy and never [[tempt:tempt]] players toward rude tricks.
After games teachers will [[designate:designate]] reading zones and [[assign:assign]] pages for [[night:night]] study.
Helpers will [[distribute:distribute]] clean worksheets and quickly [[despatch:despatch]] messages to late teammates.
To [[detach:detach]] is to [[undo:undo]] the [[knot:knot]] carefully.
Leo would not [[conceal:conceal]] the truth nor [[disguise:disguise]] his feelings.
No one should [[exclude:exclude]] others or [[refuse:refuse]] help when needed.
He would [[assure:assure]] her and never [[reverse:reverse]] his decision.
Leo will [[undertake:undertake]] extra listening drills that clearly [[stipulate:stipulate]] daily time limits.
Good scores [[can:can]] [[convince:convince]] his father and [[reassure:reassure]] his worried family at home.
Leo learns to [[aspire:aspire]] high and control wild [[desire:desire]] for games and phones.
He seems to [[yearn:yearn]] for broad knowledge and often [[invoke:invoke]] great past examples.
An [[inner:inner]] [[itch:itch]] for [[progress:progress]] drives each new [[attempt:attempt]] at difficult listening tasks.
Leo will [[strive:strive]] each evening and slowly [[fulfil:fulfil]] his weekly study plan.
A hard week [[loom:looms]] ahead, but Leo keeps calm and begins to [[sort:sort]] his cards by topic.
To [[commence:commence]] is to [[launch:launch]] the day with [[purpose:purpose]].
He would not [[exploit:exploit]] others but [[explore:explore]] new paths.
If you [[exert:exert]] effort, you [[tackle:tackle]] each [[challenge:challenge]] directly.
He learned to [[cope:cope]] with stress and [[dispose:dispose]] of worry.
His [[conduct:conduct]] was honest and nothing was left to [[omit:omit]].
He will [[erase:erase]] wrong answers quickly and [[rescue:rescue]] useful ideas from past mistakes.
Leo will not [[resort:resort]] to long naps but will [[recover:recover]] strength with short walks.
Warm tea [[can:can]] [[restore:restore]] calm focus and help [[rectify:rectify]] small grammar slips.
Extra practice [[can:can]] [[redeem:redeem]] past lazy days and [[offset:offset]] weak spelling skills.
Fresh [[fruit:fruit]] [[can:can]] [[replenish:replenish]] his energy and help him [[obtain:obtain]] [[steady:steady]] evening focus.
The [[library:library]] [[can:can]] [[supply:supply]] [[quiet:quiet]] desks that [[offer:offer]] warm light for long reading.
Tutors [[can:can]] [[render:render]] hard lessons simple and [[enlarge:enlarge]] small steps into big gains.
Pictures [[can:can]] [[augment:augment]] dull texts and [[magnify:magnify]] tiny details for tired eyes.
Microphones [[can:can]] [[amplify:amplify]] soft voices but teachers never [[exaggerate:exaggerate]] small student errors.
Leo will not [[prolong:prolong]] short breaks too long but will [[uphold:uphold]] firm sleep times.
Saved notes act as strong [[backup:backup]] and [[can:can]] [[propel:propel]] Leo toward higher bands.
Leo will [[update:update]] his word lists nightly and slowly [[raise:raise]] his practice [[test:test]] scores.
Rain may [[leak:leak]] through old windows and [[spill:spill]] cold water on [[wooden:wooden]] desks.
[[damp:Damp]] air [[can:can]] [[seep:seep]] through cracks and make old paint [[ooze:ooze]] with wet smell.
Students need not [[evacuate:evacuate]] the hall but must avoid the [[muddy:muddy]] [[trench:trench]] near the gates.
Heavy rain [[can:can]] [[saturate:saturate]] shoes quickly, a fair [[excuse:excuse]] for being slightly late.
Teachers will [[forgive:forgive]] late steps and help young minds [[contain:contain]] worry and fright.
Leo shows deep [[regard:regard]] for cleaners and never uses lies to [[flatter:flatter]] teachers.
He does not blindly [[worship:worship]] high scores or fight for a [[narrow:narrow]] [[cause:cause]].
For the [[sake:sake]] of family love Leo keeps a clear study [[purpose:purpose]].
Each small [[objective:objective]] [[can:can]] slowly [[arouse:arouse]] fresh hope in his tired heart.
A low score may [[trigger:trigger]] worry but Leo will still [[seek:seek]] wise help.
He [[can:can]] [[retrieve:retrieve]] old notes fast and let results [[testify:testify]] to hard work.
Leo will [[verify:verify]] answers twice and clearly [[specify:specify]] time for each task.
Good books [[can:can]] [[enlighten:enlighten]] young minds and warmly [[impart:impart]] timeless study skills.
Hard workers truly [[deserve:deserve]] good bands and never let focus [[drop:drop]] at [[night:night]].
Leo will not let hope [[sink:sink]] low or let scores [[plummet:plummet]] from lazy nights.
He learns to [[muffle:muffle]] [[phone:phone]] noise so stress cannot [[overshadow:overshadow]] calm thought.
At [[dawn:dawn]] he will [[greet:greet]] his mother and proudly [[salute:salute]] the morning flag.
Teachers will [[congratulate:congratulate]] his [[progress:progress]] and kind elders will [[bless:bless]] his brave path.
Leo wants to [[participate:participate]] in contests before waving a last [[farewell:farewell]] to his fears.
He will [[assort:assort]] his notes by color so that each answer still [[correspond:corresponds]] to its question.
Teachers act in kind [[accord:accord]] with rules and [[attribute:attribute]] gains to [[steady:steady]] effort.
Leo [[can:can]] [[recall:recall]] morning words well and quietly [[recollect:recollect]] evening grammar rules.
Short cards [[can:can]] [[remind:remind]] him of phrases so he [[can:can]] [[retell:retell]] stories simply.
Leo will [[repeat:repeat]] key sentences aloud and write a calm [[retrospect:retrospect]] of the day each night.
[[steady:Steady]] habits [[can:can]] [[impress:impress]] firm judges and help Leo [[surmount:surmount]] final [[test:test]] fears.
Small failures need not [[mortify:mortify]] young hearts while calm hope [[can:can]] [[pervade:pervade]] the room.
To [[replace:replace]] the old part is to [[substitute:substitute]] it entirely.
He learned to [[differentiate:differentiate]] truth from lies and [[distinguish:distinguish]] friends from foes.
He would not [[incline:incline]] to [[anger:anger]] nor [[lean:lean]] on excuses.
At last Leo turns [[sideways:sideways]] to smile at the moon and then sleeps with hope.
Grandma lost her [[temper:temper]] quickly, but she spoke in a soft [[manner:manner]] at home.
Her calm [[attitude:attitude]] shows her warm and kind [[personality:personality]] to us all.
Patience is her best [[trait:trait]], and kindness is her greatest [[virtue:virtue]] in life.
Her smile is a special [[feature:feature]], though she is bent with age and her [[stature:stature]] is less than before.
She says the [[flesh:flesh]] is weak, and that is true for all [[mankind:mankind]].
The doctor said the [[bone:bone]] in her leg is soft, and Grandpa jokes that he is still the [[backbone:backbone]] of our house.
The wall chart showed the full [[skeleton:skeleton]] and the [[round:round]] [[skull:skull]] very clearly.
A strong [[brain:brain]] needs good sleep, and a calm [[mind:mind]] needs love each day.
Grandma needs both [[physical:physical]] care and warm [[mental:mental]] support from the family.
The [[nurse:nurse]] touched her red [[cheek:cheek]] and warm [[forehead:forehead]] with [[gentle:gentle]] hands.
Sweat stood on her [[brow:brow]], and tears hung on her long [[eyelash:eyelashes]] that morning.
Her dry [[lip:lips]] were bitten, and she asked for more [[space:space]] to breathe in the room.
She put out her [[tongue:tongue]] and the doctor looked deep into her red [[throat:throat]] quickly.
She lifts her small [[chin:chin]] to answer loudly, remembering the green [[gorge:gorge]] where she lived as a girl.
Her stiff [[jaw:jaw]] ached a little, so she slowly moved her long [[neck:neck]] left and right.
Grandpa stroked his grey [[beard:beard]] and put his hand on her shaking [[shoulder:shoulder]] softly.
